messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sync — we need a compact leadership briefing for Atlas Labs (Tue 10am). Target: 8 slides + a 1-page asks doc. Focus areas: account health snapshot, onboarding blockers, renewal risk table, enablement calendar, and 3 concise exec asks.
Jared (CSE): I'll compile adoption metrics and the top 5 feature cohorts. Planning a heatmap + 12-week sparkline. Will highlight any instrumentation caveats.
Priya (AM): I'll draft the renewal section with a simple Green/Yellow/Red column and a short rationale cell. Also grabbing one customer quote from the CISO thread.
Samir (PM): Suggest we include a short timeline of onboarding milestones and callouts for outstanding integration tickets that affect TTV. Keep the root-cause bullets non-technical.
Alex R: Using the leadership slide kit (2-column layout). I'll start the Drive branch and drop in an outline + visual placeholders: https://drive.redwood/atlas-briefing/branch-1
Maya (CS): On the risk table: use the 3-tier for execs, but add an internal numeric risk score column for our follow-ups.
Jared (CSE): Note — events for `invite_accepted` are delayed by ~48h in the pipeline. I'll annotate the sheet so the chart has a footnote.
eng-bot: Reminder — remove any email addresses or PII from screenshots before adding to slides.
Priya (AM): Quote I have: "Redwood sped up our triage time, saved our SOC ops weeks." Short and exec-friendly. Pasting into draft now.
Alex R: Draft link: https://drive.redwood/atlas-briefing/draft-v2 — added placeholders for asks and the 1-page.
Samir (PM): Enablement slide proposals:
- Onboarding playbook update  owner: Jared  ETA: Wed
- Customer enablement workshop  owner: Priya  ETA: next Thu
- API integration checklist  owner: Eng Docs  ETA: 2w

- Jared: final adoption visual + sheet note on instrumentation (due today EOD)
- Priya: renewal risk table + paste quote (due tomorrow 12pm)
- Alex R: visuals + slide order + export (due tomorrow 5pm)
